## Summary

What changed and why? Link the issue.

## Verification

List commands run and what they showed, or explain why no checks apply.

## Data, privacy, and source review

- [ ] No secrets or private witness data in commits or screenshots.
- [ ] Source terms and attribution reviewed for new feeds or reused code.
- [ ] Original evidence remains separate from derived analysis.
- [ ] Location and uncertainty behavior checked where relevant.

## Collaboration

Note any material AI assistance and what you verified yourself. Flag shared contract changes or unresolved decisions.
